The perspective lines of the text and the sign borders do not align perfectly. The letters themselves warp slightly along the length of the sign, suggesting a lack of rigid planar geometry.
The pole lacks a consistent texture (e.g., brushed metal, rust, or wood grain). It appears as a smooth, noisy gradient that doesn't reflect light realistically compared to the bright signs.
